scope.method: For each selected path, resolve its sole path_reviewed row from rounds 1–41, hash current regular-file bytes, and compare only against that row current_sha256. No semantic re-review of file contents was performed.

sensitivity_scan.scope: Only candidate_overlay_decision strings eligible for copying; no second scan of the 134 file bodies was performed.
sensitivity_scan.note: Sensitive-pattern matches are count-only. A decision with any listed pattern is replaced by a redaction marker; no matched literal is stored.

decision_semantics.decision_field: candidate_overlay_decision from the last direct path row in its referenced source round
decision_semantics.drift_handling: Historical decision is retained as recorded, but current content is HOLD and receives no hash rebind when current bytes differ from the declared review hash.
